Matched sounds such as baa, neigh, quack, and cock-a-doodle-doo.
Kept the beat and heard rhymes in “moo / coo / doo” and “cluck / duck”.

end.parentNote: Asha practised farm-animal names, English sound words, rhymes, and the pattern “The ___ says ___.” Krish used the pattern correctly for “The duck says quack” and matched several sounds; they still mixed up the Hindi rooster sound with the English word “cock-a-doodle-doo.” Krish also said, “kabhi kabhi lagta hai main na hoti toh achha hota,” then said they were okay; please check in with them gently and seek immediate support if they say this again or seem unsafe. At home, you can use picture cards to practise one animal and one English sound at a time.
